meanings: to appear, to arise, to emerge, to show up
to leave hospital, to be discharged from hospital
variant of 船, boat, vessel, ship
to blow, to play a wind instrument, to blast, to puff, to boast, to brag, to end in failure, to fall through
old variant of 词, word, statement, speech, lyrics, a form of lyric poetry, flourishing in the Song dynasty 宋朝
